evidence: 0097 (B6, owner decisions of 2026-10-28, phone and computer notifications by standard Web Push with VAPID and no payload; signed by D-Eminence under the batch approval of 2026-10-28) is additive. One new table, notification.web_push_subscriptions, with row-level security enabled and forced, one policy for its owner, no grant to any role (only the new SECURITY DEFINER commands touch it): a patient's browser subscription (id chosen by Identity; account and patient with foreign keys; session_family_id, the sign-in that turned it on, with no foreign key to auth.sessions; status active or removed; the endpoint only as its SHA-256 and AES-256-GCM ciphertext of 30-2100 bytes, both required while active and erased on removal; key version, push service fcm, mozilla, apple or windows, VAPID key id; delivered_through watermark, claimed_through, last delivery and count, attempts 0-6, consecutive rejections 0-3, next attempt, lease owner and expiry, last outcome code, removal reason from a fixed list, times and row_version, with a CHECK per state); partial unique indexes on the digest and on the sign-in among active rows and an account index; a guard trigger refuses deletes, any update of a removed row and changes of id, account, patient or created_at. The browser's p256dh and auth keys are never stored. Eleven new functions, every body PL/pgSQL (creating them reads no table), SECURITY DEFINER with search_path pg_catalog, pg_temp except the plain guard trigger function: internal, granted to no role, identity.web_push_audit (ids, codes and counts only: never an endpoint, digest, key or session id), identity.web_push_remove, identity.web_push_sign_in_live (a row of the family not revoked, not idle-expired, not past its absolute end, the current token version, account and patient active, not deletion-due; the claim also refuses a temporarily disabled account) and the two trigger functions; the patient's subscribe_my_web_push, unsubscribe_my_web_push and list_my_web_push_subscriptions, bound to 0096's identity.patient_self_session (42501 without a live patient session; 22023 for malformed arguments), under advisory locks per account and per endpoint (another account's row of the same endpoint removed as endpoint_reassigned, one per sign-in, the same endpoint rebound keeping its id, at most 10 per patient with the least recently bound removed); the sweeper's claim_web_push_deliveries, record_web_push_outcome and prune_web_push_subscriptions (system:auth only; the claim takes subscriptions of the current key id that are not leased, past their retry time, not pushed in the last 2 minutes, with an unread inbox item newer than their watermark and a live sign-in, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, at most 500 examined and 1-50 leased for 15-600 s; outcomes accepted, gone (removed), retry after 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 minutes or Retry-After up to an hour, the sixth dropped, rejected an hour and the third in a row removed; the prune erases subscriptions of ended sign-ins as session_ended or account_closed). A new trigger accounts_deleted_web_push AFTER UPDATE OF status ON auth.accounts FOR EACH ROW WHEN (new.status = 'deleted' AND old.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'deleted') erases the account's subscriptions inside 0096's completion and never raises. No trigger on notification.inbox_items and no change to the enqueue path or any existing function; 0097 replaces nothing. Preconditions, catalog reads only, nothing applied on failure: the prerequisites of 0001-0096; not already applied; the md5 of the nine bodies called or relied on (patient_self_session, patient_account_deletion_due, complete_patient_account_deletion, protect_deleted_account, enqueue_patient_inbox_item, current_actor_subject, current_correlation_id, reject_mutation, authorize_platform_event); the CHECKs accounts_status_check, patient_session_identity_binding, sessions_session_kind_check and sessions_check2; the indexes sessions_family_idx, notification_inbox_account_idx and notification_inbox_unread_idx; the compared columns' types and nullability; the triggers on audit.events and accounts_deleted_terminal; the applying role's privileges by ownership, membership or grant, never a superuser's bypass (owner of identity.patients with its RLS enabled and not forced; SELECT, UPDATE, REFERENCES and TRIGGER on auth.accounts; REFERENCES on identity.patients; SELECT on auth.sessions and notification.inbox_items; INSERT on audit.events; CREATE on notification and identity; USAGE on the five schemas; EXECUTE on the functions called). Post-checks: owners, forced RLS and the one policy, an owner-only table ACL, SECURITY DEFINER and search_path, the trigger definitions, the md5 pins, and after the grants every function ACL. Locks: SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE on auth.accounts and identity.patients (the foreign keys and the trigger), taken up front in that order, NOWAIT every 10 ms for at most 5 seconds, then 55P03 with nothing applied; measured with pg_locks before commit on a copy at 0096: those two with ACCESS SHARE and ACCESS SHARE on their primary keys, ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on the new table, its indexes and TOAST table, ACCESS SHARE on the two trigger functions, SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE on the six commented functions, the temporary helper and the catalogs; no lock on auth.sessions, notification.inbox_items, audit.events or any other application table, and none on an existing function. Grants, in the migration and repeated in runtime-grants.sql: EXECUTE on the six commands to hid_identity_runtime and hid_schema_test_runtime; none on the helpers or trigger functions; none on the table; nothing to the EHR, Lab, Pharmacy or Notification runtimes. Measured on the throwaway PostgreSQL 16 cluster as pgrun: a copy holding the committed 0001-0096 (0096 checksum 37d163bd8e6bc3cf9232a6c99d49560cea1bf5d0120f39cac9669ffd2ed4e135) took 0097 planned, dry-run and applied by the runner (122 ms; 12 function grants from the migration itself), a rerun found 0 pending, the file applied again stopped with 55000 0097: already applied, the role bootstrap and verify-only passed; a fresh database took 0001-0097 in one dry run and one apply; a copy owned by a NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS owner applied 0097 as that owner; copies with a drifted enqueue_patient_inbox_item body, a dropped sessions_check2, an applying role that does not own identity.patients and a dropped notification_inbox_unread_idx stopped with nothing applied; a write held on auth.accounts or identity.patients stopped the runner after 5.5 s with 55P03 and nothing applied, and it applied once the write ended. All 71 suites (16 in database/tests, 55 in test/database) pass on the upgraded and the fresh copy, among them the new test/database/patient-web-push.integration.sql (the boundary; subscribe, re-subscribe, rebind, one per sign-in, reassignment, the 10 limit, unsubscribe and list; 42501 without a live session, after logout, after a token version change and with a deletion due; a refresh keeps the subscription; the claim's new-unread-item, 2-minute, key id, ended and suspended sign-in rules, the lease and its expiry; every outcome and the backoff and Retry-After values; the prune's reasons; deletion erasing them in 0096's finalizer; the guard; audit rows without an endpoint, digest or session id) and the extended runtime-command-privileges suite (no runtime login role reads, writes or locks the table; the Identity login role runs the system commands, the Notification roles cannot); seven definer suites pass with the NOSUPERUSER owner; two sessions claiming at once neither wait nor lease a row twice (SKIP LOCKED); six mutants of 0097 (no 2-minute coalescing, read items pushed, a signed-out sign-in live, deletion keeping subscriptions, linear backoff, no reassignment) each fail the web push suite. Old images on this schema: the previous Identity calls none of the new functions and reads nothing new; the trigger fires only on the transition to deleted and touches only the new table; EHR, Lab, Pharmacy and Notification use nothing new. Applied migrations 0001-0096 are unchanged.
